text:
marie: FYI Escrow Inc raised a billing dispute. Their May invoice (INV-9802) includes a 6-month escrow deposit line after their Private migration. Customer says escrow was optional and should've been quoted separately. Link: https://invoices.internal/INV-9802 cc @sophia

tony: I pulled the order. During migration we showed an optional "escrow deposit" checkbox in the UI and the account team selected it, but the sales quote shows escrow as optional add-on. The order capture shows it as a separate line but the invoice grouped it under platform_fee_bundle.

sophia: Customer email: "we never agreed to escrow, please remove charge" dated 2026-05-12. They want immediate credit and removal from recurring billing.

ed: Invoice snippet:
```
platform_fee_bundle  45,000.00  05/01-05/31
escrow_deposit       18,000.00  6-month deposit 05/12
```
The system mistakenly created escrow as recurring due to a templating issue, not a one-time deposit. We need to reverse recurring schedule and decide whether to refund or hold the deposit (customer asked for removal).

marie: Legal & finance - what's our standard on escrow when it's optional but selected by internal ops? If ops selected by mistake, we should credit. If customer selected, we typically keep deposit unless contract says otherwise. Need evidence of selection. @legal

legal: If there's no signed addendum indicating escrow, and customer says they didn't agree, lean towards crediting and removing recurring flag. But ask sales to confirm who clicked it. Also attach the UI audit log.

sales-bot: Sales notes show AE "checked escrow option during migration call" on 2026-05-11 but no separate signed SOW. There's an internal comment: "AE to send escrow T&C and invoice to customer" which appears unfulfilled.

tony: Checking UI audit: event shows "escrow_opt_in by operations (user: kyle) 2026-05-11 14:12:03". So ops clicked it. Kyle, can you confirm?

kyle: Confirmed I clicked the opt-in as part of migration checklist. I misunderstood that this would only schedule a one-time deposit invoice and not set a recurring line. My bad.

sophia: Given that ops error caused the recurring escrow line, propose: 1) Issue full credit for the recurring portion billed on INV-9802 ($18,000) as a one-time credit memo; 2) Remove recurring flag so future invoices not charged; 3) Offer to reissue a one-time deposit invoice only if customer signs explicit escrow agreement. Approve?

ed: Financials: escrow deposit GL mapping is 2-200-CustomerDeposits (liability) when received. If we credit it back, move from liability reduction. For revenue correction we need memo: "escrow misapplied - ops opt-in error". Approve amount and GL?

marie: Approve credit memo for $18,000 applied to INV-9802. GL: reverse from 2-200-CustomerDeposits. Add audit note: "escrow deposit removed - ops selection, awaiting signed escrow T&C to re-bill". No cash refund, credit memo applied. @ed create ADJ.

billing-bot: Adjustment created: ADJ-14077 amount: -18000.00 status: pending approval.

ed: Creating ADJ-14077 now. Will attach UI audit log and customer email. Will set memo per marie.

legal: Also prepare a short template escrow addendum with explicit checkbox language and signature so this doesn't repeat. Sales please circulate.

sales-bot: Will push addendum and require AE signature + customer sign-off for any future escrow. Adding requirement to migration checklist.

kyle: Sorry team. I'll update the ops runbook and make the checkbox show a modal that requires review before opt-in.

marie: One more ask from customer: they want a confirmation note that we won't auto-renew deposit after 6 months. Can we include that in the credit memo and addendum?

ed: Yes, include clause: "no auto-renew; one-time refundable deposit unless explicit SOW" in the memo. ADJ-14077 will reference that.

billing-bot: ADJ-14077 posted and applied to INV-9802. Amount: $18,000.00 credit. Link: https://billing.internal/adj/ADJ-14077. Attachments: UI audit log, customer email.

sophia: Customer replied: "Thanks for quick action. We'll sign escrow addendum if needed but won't proceed without signed T&C." Closing ticket from customer side.

marie: I'll update monthly reconciliation and mark this as "ops-billing-ops training" item. Filing PROD ticket to change UI. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
